source_roman: Once Jagannatha dasaru visited a holy place called surpur. There he noticed a poor man, who was so anxious and sad. He then called the poor man and asked the reason behind his sadness. The poor brahmin replied he was extremely poor and not having sufficient funds for even a day meal. Jagannatha dasaru on his medidation found, that poor brahman in his previous birth has not donated any dhaana or dharma. That was the reason for his poverty in this birth. Jagannatha dasaru asked “What you are having with you to sell or give?”He replied other than a copper kalasa, he didnt have anything. Jagannatha dasaru asked him to sell the copper vessel and with that money he asked him to prepare panaka and to give it to him and other bhaktas in the temple. Brahmin did the same. After selling copper vessel, he prepared panaka and gave it to jagannatha dasaru and other hari bhaktas. Jagannatha dasaru composed Narasimha suladhi and He gave  upadesha to the brahmin. the brahmin also with full bakthi started reciting suladhi. course of time, Narasima swamy blessed him with good status and even a highest job postion in surpur sarkar.  This is a powerful suladhi, if recited with complete devotion and dedication will help us to get rid of all difficulties in life
Vatha janara priya nine gathi emage ihaparadhi ||
NA samudhrane olidhu emma manadha abi
Ashe purthiya madi emmanu dhayadhi u
Thugalane keli tha nagutha kamitha bage

गा०गेय समभा०ग कुमतमात०ग स०घ सितपि०ग नमो
केवलनतजन पावनरूप सदाविनोदि हे पालय मा०    || ३ ||
श्री सुधी०द्र करजात नमो नमो भूसुरनुत विख्यात नमो
दैशिकवरस०सेव्य नमो नमो दोषविवर्जित काव्य नमो
व्यासराम पद भक्त नमो नमो शाश्वतधर्मासक्त नमो    || ४ ||
चिह्नित द०डकम०डल पु०ड्र प्रसन्न भयापह जय जय भो
मान्य महात्म प्रसन्नवदन कारुण्य पयोनिधि जय जय भो
धन्य क्षमास०पन्न धरामरशरण्य सदार्चित जय जय भो    || ५ ||

source_roman: rohini ramana maddehagehaadigala moha pariharisi manadalli |

Budha neenu sugunavaaridhiyendu binnaipe kshudheya pariharisi suj~jaana |
Chandranandana satata vandisuve manmanada sandeha bidisayya mama daiva |
Nutisi beduve bruhaspati guruve ennadurmatiya pariharisi suj~jaana |
Taaraaramanane madbhaara ninnadu mahaakaarunika neenemdu binnaipe |
Binnaipe duritava nivaarisi toro tava roopa || 2 ||

kannada: ದಾ ಗಂಡಕಿ ಭಿಮರಥಿ ತುಂಗಭದ್ರೆ ಪ್ರಯಾಗ ತ್ರಿವೇಣಿ ಹೇಮಾ
ಶ್ವರಿ ಶಂಖ ಚಕ್ರವತಿ ಭವನಾಶಿನಿ ಗದಾಧರ ಮೇನಕಾ
ಮರುದ್ವತಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಣಮುಖರಿ ವರ ಝರತಾಪಿನಿ ಕಾಳಿ ಸೌ
ದೇವವತಿ ಪಾತಾಳ ಗಂಗಾ ಪುನಹ ನೀರಾ ಕುಮಾರಧಾರಾ
ದಾರ ನರನಾರಾಯಣ ಶ್ರೀ ಮಜ್ಜಗನ್ನಾಥ ಶ್ರೀ ಮುಷ್ಣ
iast: dā gaṃḍaki bhimarathi tuṃgabhadrè prayāga triveṇi hemā
śvari śaṃkha cakravati bhavanāśini gadādhara menakā
marudvati svarṇamukhari vara jharatāpini kāḻi sau
devavati pātāḻa gaṃgā punaha nīrā kumāradhārā
dāra naranārāyaṇa śrī majjagannātha śrī muṣṇa
devanagari: दा गंडकि भिमरथि तुंगभद्रॆ प्रयाग त्रिवेणि हेमा

मरुद्वति स्वर्णमुखरि वर झरतापिनि काळि सौ
देववति पाताळ गंगा पुनह नीरा कुमारधारा
दार नरनारायण श्री मज्जगन्नाथ श्री मुष्ण
source_roman: dA ganDaki Bimarathi tuNgaBadre prayAga trivENi hEmA

dEvavati pAtALa gaNgA punaha nIrA kumAradhArA
dAra naranArAyaNa SrI majjagannAtha SrI muShNa

title.devanagari: Sri Hari Kathamruta Saara/श्री हरि कथामृत सार

kannada: ಪಂಚತನ್ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಂಧಿ / Pancha tanmathra sandhi/Durita Nivaraana sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ವರ್ಣಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Sri VarnaPrakriya sandhi /
ಶ್ರೀ ಸ್ಥಾವರಜಂಗಮ ಸಂಧಿ/Sthavarajangama sandhi/ Dhyaana prakriyasandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಪಿತೃಗಣ ಸಂಧಿ / Pithruguna sandhi / Jeevanaprakriya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ದತ್ತಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Dhatthasvathanthriya sandhi / SwAtantrnya vibhajane Sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಕ್ರೀಡಾವಿಲಾಸ ಸಂಧಿ/Kreedavilasa sandhi / sarvaswatantrya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಬಿಂಬಾಪರೋಕ್ಷ ಸಂಧಿ / Bimbaparoksha sandhi/ Bimbopasana sandhi / Bimba pratibimba sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಗುಣತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Guna Taratamya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಕರ್ಮ ವಿಮೋಚನ ಸಂಧಿ / Karma vimochana sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಕ್ತಾಪರಾಧಸಹಿಷ್ಣು ಸಂಧಿ / Bhaktaradhasahishnu sandhi /SakaladuritanivaaraNa Sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಬೃಹತ್ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Bruhat taratamya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಕಲ್ಪಸಾಧನ ಸಂಧಿ/ಶ್ರೀ ಅಪರೋಕ್ಷ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ/Kalpa sadhana sandhi/Aparoksha Taratamya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಆರೋಹಣ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ/Aarohana taratamya sandhi

ಶ್ರೀ ಅಣುತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Anu taratamya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ದೈತ್ಯತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Dhaithya taratamya sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ನೈವೇದ್ಯಪ್ರಕರಣ ಸಂಧಿ / Neivedhya prakarana sandhi
ಶ್ರೀ ಕಕ್ಷಾತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಸಂಧಿ / Kaksha taratamya sandhi

śrī pitṛgaṇa saṃdhi / Pithruguna sandhi / Jeevanaprakriya sandhi
śrī dattasvātaṃtrya saṃdhi / Dhatthasvathanthriya sandhi / SwAtantrnya vibhajane Sandhi

śrī anukramaṇikā tāratamya saṃdhi / Anukramanika tharatamya sandhi

श्री क्रीडाविलास संधि/Kreedavilasa sandhi / sarvaswatantrya sandhi

श्री गुणतारतम्य संधि / Guna Taratamya sandhi
श्री कर्म विमोचन संधि / Karma vimochana sandhi
श्री भक्तापराधसहिष्णु संधि / Bhaktaradhasahishnu sandhi /SakaladuritanivaaraNa Sandhi

श्री आरोहण तारतम्य संधि/Aarohana taratamya sandhi
श्री अवरोहण तारतम्य संधि/Avarohana taratamya sandhi
श्री अनुक्रमणिका तारतम्य संधि / Anukramanika tharatamya sandhi
श्री विघ्नेश्वर स्तोत्र संधि/श्री गणपति स्तोत्र संधि
श्री अणुतारतम्य संधि / Anu taratamya sandhi
श्री दैत्यतारतम्य संधि / Dhaithya taratamya sandhi
श्री नैवेद्यप्रकरण संधि / Neivedhya prakarana sandhi
श्री कक्षातारतम्य संधि / Kaksha taratamya sandhi
source_roman: HarikathamrutasAra is the magnum opus composition of Sri Jagannatha Dasaru. This great  composition is written in Bhamini Shatpadi and consists of thirty two chapters explaining both jnana and its means. It starts with a benediction prayer to all deities as per the hierarchy.
The phala sruthy of this great work is written by Srida vittala dasaru.
